reasoning: At each integer time, keep the greatest total production rate achievable for each resource balance; a lower rate with the same balance is dominated. Advance all states by one discrete harvest and stop at the first target-reaching time. Prune only globally dominated peon types with no lower price and no higher efficiency; cap production at the target because any such rate reaches it at the next harvest.
